Under the proposed scope principle, the latter cannot be fully answered while its included B lacks an adequate reason; does not imply universal existential coverage. Two populated finite worlds retain one brute contingent base each, all derivative reason assignments, fixed identities, invariant constraints and a correct resident-observer identity decoder. Role-only observations cannot distinguish occupants uniformly; conditioning on the actual essentially dependent D0 screens off its base-absence world. Finite assignments and rational probability samples checked with a standalone Python diagnostic, not a Lean certificate. A necessary exemption can be directly warranted without falling within the being-level contingent PSR; even a contingent rule fact is not automatically a being. Positive priority, conditional essence, necessary role occupancy and intrinsic self-intelligibility have distinct explanatory scopes. The inspected firstMoverNecessaryByEsseCause proof uses B2 only at its selected f; a mover-scoped strength restriction is proposed, not registered or checked for novelty. Retain BX1/BX2 and actual firstness/priority/existence premises. A nonnecessitating actual reason may explain the recipient without uniquely determining an act; scope, operative content and actual production remain separate. No premise established, no new formal edge or source claim. Prior accepted E/D and practical-content assessments remain intact. In any sound reason model a specific actual reason for an absent-at-an-accessible-world bearer cannot persist there. Necessity of content alone need not give that edge transport. Five matched fact-level assignments preserve all truth profiles and distinguish a borrowed cycle, unexplained primitive application, nonnecessitating nature reason and represented contingent-fact coverage. Standalone finite diagnostic passed. Positive nonreceipt licenses and ontic reasons remain distinct. A proposed external-reason availability weakening of BX1 retains PSR and BX2 and is structurally weaker by the existing conserved/selfAndOccasion control; combined mover-scoping is pending canonical preflight. All finite checks ran successfully in standalone Python; structural surrogates do not certify metaphysical possibility or the calibration to limited esse. A whole-first mode cannot supply its own whole's existence in the same asymmetric grounding relation if its existence depends on that whole. Even a successful limitation-to-reception principle leaves the qualitatively unrestricted but contingently actual rival unless C→L or a separate modal grounding bridge holds. Existing Route C uses B6 only on its selected f; localized R1/B6 application is a proposed strength restriction, not a new formal result. current_assessment.scope: Inclusive existence scope, actual intrinsic reasons, qualitative limitation versus modal vulnerability, reception and same-mover coverage
current_assessment.assessment: Repaired synthesis pending targeted review: a contained brute input leaves the inclusive actual-existence question unanswered if that question covers the very base and the scope principle is accepted. This is explanatory incompleteness, not a contradiction, independent derivative bruteness or universal epistemic failure. Fixed-role constraints, a positive exemption criterion and reliable cognitive inference are compatible with the displayed structural assignments. Essential identity information may remove occupant ambiguity, without supplying an ontic why. The token-inclusive demand requires a reason for this B. A replacement source can compete on the different question of the same derivatives' existence where their identities and dependencies permit replacement. If a adequately explains b, leaving a primitive matters only for a demand covering a or all indispensable input facts when a is one. Coverage of every member’s existence alone imposes no separate act-fact demand. The same scope applies to a necessary producer’s contingent exercise. No adequate necessary source or personal-over-impersonal ranking is established. Retain the earlier moderate preference for E and suspension about D; no change to their accepted review status. The exact world-free natureModel with global Sound rules out contingency of its identity-conditioned bearer; this isolates rather than warrants the existential import. World-relative factive nonnecessitating reason assignments survive without fixed-edge transport; co-truth cannot distinguish borrowing from constitutive direction. A positively justified nonreceipt license can permit a primitive causal stop without supplying an ontic why. Selected external reason availability may replace universal BX1 for the conditional route, pending canonical formalization; no reduction of the philosophical burden of explaining the first mover's existence is claimed. The new limitation comparison leaves the earlier E/D and C2 assessments unchanged. Two independent bridges are required for the participation route; stable type-specific capacities can explain bounded operations without demonstrating a separate recipient, and all four populated overlays have finite profiles. Proper-subset coverage of a fixed two-feature operational domain varies independently of represented contingency. The response supplies no warrant for reception of existence. A real qualitative limitation of esse needs an independent calibration, and even granting the limitation-to-reception rule does not exclude unlimited contingent actuality. Whole-first dependence cannot be reversed to explain the same whole's existence on an asymmetric ground relation. No universal incompatibility, genuine metaphysical counterexample, or premise discharge is inferred. The existing Route C same-mover application also permits a proposed localized R1/B6 scope restriction.
current_assessment.next_test: The necessary-law comparison in docs/notes/foundational-absence-warrant.md#12-can-a-necessary-law-license-omission-of-the-unrestricted-bearer retains suspension at the unrestricted n. Reopen on independent warrant for one complete realization excluding n even as an additional bearer, or show that the law required in every order entails an indispensable exercise by this very n. Reproducing all effects leaves n’s presence open. Separate omissions need not be jointly possible, and joint omission of the effects can leave n present. Apply the result at the First Way only for the same mover. In the finite branch, reopen the two limitation bridges with a same-sense positive ceiling or causal-perfection witness, keeping actual intrinsic possession distinct from productive capacity. Retain the existing unresolved nature-reason/adequacy and PSR/B2 scope proposals and #1933's blockers. Run canonical related/novelty/semantics before registering any new bridge. For Route C retain explicit EM, actual mover, simplicity and pure act; for the B2 route retain B1/B3 and causal interpretations.
